context.transcript:
Welcome to Comfortable Footwear.
Can I help you find something?
Yes.
I know you carry a wide selection of shoes, but I'm wondering if you also sell socks.
I'm looking for athletic socks to wear while running.
We usually do, but unfortunately we don't have any athletic socks in stock right now.
Oh no.
I'm running in a race this weekend.
Well, I'll check if our second store location has any.
They can send them here this afternoon if they do.
